mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super from Cell (Perfect) training. The user swings an arm to create a frontal sweeping attack that knocks the opponent away and can negate Ki Waves. It can also be used while guarding; current Xenoverse 2 evidence describes the guard use as invulnerable for the duration and reports about 10% damage. The numerical value remains source-reported rather than a patch-independent constant.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
